title: Quick check: useEffect Fundamentals

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “useEffect Fundamentals”?
options: The concept allows application code to mutate React-managed DOM and state directly.
Synchronizing with external systems should synchronize with an external system and clean up obsolete work when needed.
The concept removes the need to consider error states or accessibility.
The browser will infer all application behavior even if inputs and state are contradictory.
questions.answer_key: Synchronizing with external systems should synchronize with an external system and clean up obsolete work when needed.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in useEffect Fundamentals: Synchronizing with external systems should synchronize with an external system and clean up obsolete work when needed.

questions.prompt: Which practice is most reliable when applying Synchronizing with external systems?
options: Include reactive dependencies and clean up subscriptions or requests that are no longer current.
Skip validation because a successful render proves that the application is correct.
Store duplicate copies of every value so each component can change it independently.
Optimize by adding every available Hook without measuring the result.
questions.answer_key: Include reactive dependencies and clean up subscriptions or requests that are no longer current.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in useEffect Fundamentals: Include reactive dependencies and clean up subscriptions or requests that are no longer current.

questions.prompt: What should you verify before considering “useEffect Fundamentals” complete?
options: Check only whether the file exists; syntax and runtime behavior do not matter.
Assume a client-side check proves that a remote service accepted the change.
Rely only on a screenshot of the happy path and never repeat the test.
Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.answer_key: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
questions.explanation: The correct choice is grounded in useEffect Fundamentals: Verify the documented result with a normal example and at least one boundary, loading, or failure case.
